svg.aria-label: ai-session-handoff overview: one Node script, handoff-guard.mjs, wired into Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI and xAI Grok Build through their hook configs. It reads and writes hand-off notes under the tool's own home folder and asks git about a 100 percent claim. Nothing leaves your machine.
svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: ai-session-handoff · one script, three AI coding tools
Each tool runs the same Node file at its hook moments; it saves each chat's recap as a note, shows it to the next chat, and checks a "100% done" claim against git.
YOUR MACHINE · NO NETWORK CALLS · NO DEPENDENCIES · NO TELEMETRY

g.text: PostCompact · statusLine (live context gauge + progress bar)
no status line: run list to see the notes yourself

svg.text: hook JSON in on stdin → decision or text out on stdout

g.text: one file · Node built-ins only · each hook mode exits 0 and never throws
--host SWITCH → WHICH HOME FOLDER HOLDS THE NOTES
HOOK MODES (each reads the hook's JSON on stdin)
stop save this chat's last recap as its note
complete-check block a 100% recap missing a docs/memory step
session-start show a new chat the notes for this folder
prompt handed-off chat: stop work · big chat: nudge
pretool handed-off chat: refuse every tool but a stop
posttool Grok only: deliver text the start hook could not
compacted keep the compaction summary on the note
statusline context gauge + this chat's progress bar
COMMANDS (typed by the model when it continues a note, or by you)
resume-here <session> lift the mark; carry on in that chat
notes other chats' notes, wrapped as data, for the model
list this folder's notes as bars + ages, for you
secrets are scrubbed before any note is written
notes are shown as DATA, NOT INSTRUCTIONS, inside marked fences
HANDOFF_GUARD_DISABLE=1 switches the whole thing off
plain JSON you can read, copy or delete · under the tool's own home folder
one note per chat (slug = the folder path)
Grok: text owed to the next tool call
Grok: context size for the gauge
one line per hook run, for debugging
session_id · cwd · started · updated · name · context_tokens
summary (the recap, ≤ 1,800 chars) · progress { pct, label, steps, next }
compact_summary after a compaction · written atomically (temp file + rename)
Only when a recap says 100%: did the .md/.mdx/.txt files the docs
step names really change, in the listed commits or the working tree?
If not, the reply is blocked with a reason and the model must fix it.
(Codex: asked only when git shows files changed since the chat began)
What the next chat in that folder sees at startup
